args.title: Launch arguments
args.description: Added to every Codex start in a tmuxedo pane, in this order.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model Codex starts with (--model). Empty leaves Codex's own choice.

bypassApprovals.title: Never ask and no sandbox
bypassApprovals.x-dangerous: Codex runs commands without asking and outside its sandbox. Use it only in a place you can throw away.

extras.title: Load tmuxedo extras
extras.description: The tmuxedo skill and the items you enable here. Off starts the agent with only what you set up yourself.
